content.title: Convert SVG to JPG Format
content.p1: Need to use a logo in a document or on a website that doesn't accept vector files? Our SVG to JPG Converter is the answer.
content.p2: It creates a solid, high-compatibility image file from your vector source. We automatically handle transparency by adding a clean white background, ensuring your graphic looks professional on any medium.

features.title: Key Features
features.f1_desc: JPG is opened by literally every digital device and software created in the last 30 years.
features.f2_desc: Scale up your SVG before saving to ensure your JPG is sharp, not blurry.
features.f3_desc: Processing happens in your browser. We never see your files.

how_to.title: Easy Instructions
how_to.step1_desc: Click "Upload" or drag your file to the center box.
how_to.step2_desc: Choose a scaling factor (e.g., 2x or 4x) for higher quality results.
how_to.step3_desc: Observe the image. Note that transparent backgrounds are now white.

why.title: Why choose JPG over PNG for Vectors?
why.p1: While PNG supports transparency, JPG generates smaller file sizes for complex, colorful images.
list: Smaller Files: Better for emails and attachments.
No Transparency Issues: Some viewers render transparency as black. JPG forces a white background, ensuring your logo is legible.
